runs.t: By investing in fintech solutions that prioritize digitization, EFG Holding helps reduce barriers to entry and broaden participation in the formal financial system. This digital approach strengthens financial inclusion by making services more accessible, transparent, and responsive to evolving customer needs.

EFG Holding brings together a complementary suite of technology-enabled platforms designed to broaden access to financial services across the lifecycle. Through digital insurance (Kaf), consumer finance solutions (Valu), structured and sustainable finance advisory (EFG Corp-Solutions), and SME lending (EFG Finance SMEs) under the EFG

Finance vertical and retail investment access (EFG Hermes ONE) under the EFG Hermes vertical, the ecosystem addresses different but interconnected financial needs. Together, these platforms leverage digitization to reduce barriers, expand participation, and promote more inclusive engagement in the formal financial system.
Expanded access to formal finance for underserved micro and small enterprises
Opening wealth-building opportunities to new investor segments
Channelling capital toward sectors that expand economic participation
Tech-led, affordable insurance for everyday protection
An integrated suite of consumer and merchant solutions promoting financial empowerment and inclusion
